question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes** the characteristics of the room, including why it feels chill.**
 
• The** appropriate word** should indicate the frequency of the room being heated or having a fire.
 
• "**Seldom**" fits well as it denotes** infrequency, which aligns with the room being chill.**

Therefore, the correct sentence is** "****This room was chill, because it seldom __had a fire; it was silent,............."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("usually", "frequently", "often") suggest a higher frequency, which does not fit the context of explaining why the room is chill.

 
• **Usually** (आमतौर पर): ""Usually"" implies regularity and common occurrence, which does not match with the idea of the room being chill due to lack of fire.
 
• **Frequently** (अक्सर): ""Frequently"" indicates something happens often, which contradicts the reason the room is chill.
 
• **Often** (अक्सर): ""Often"" also suggests a higher occurrence frequency and does not fit the context well.
